Compiles with the generic section, olean written. Note EXITTAG printed empty — `$LASTEXITCODE` may be null because of pipeline; the overall run_code exit was 0 and no errors printed. Let me do a clean verification run capturing exit code properly, and also run the axiom check listing (currently truncated at 40 lines). Also double check no `sorry` in the file and get the SHA256.

Let me also update the top docstring to mention the generic section and the precise status. And add a final `#print axioms` for the generic theorems.

Then: final verification run with explicit `$?` / `$LASTEXITCODE`, SHA256, olean info.

Additionally, I should consider updating coord/STATE.md / AUDIT_LEDGER.md? The AGENTS.md says each package should end by updating node, STATE, queue, and append research facts to AUDIT_LEDGER. As a subagent with a specific file deliverable, I should at least append a short entry to AUDIT_LEDGER.md (append-only) documenting the finding. That's aligned with the instructions. Let me do a concise append.

Let me first finalize the Lean file docstring + axiom list, compile, then update the ledger, then report to parent.

For the docstring update, I'll add a paragraph about the generic section and about what is not proved. Let me use edit on the header docstring: append after "Status (see S1894ExactMissing)" paragraph.

Current header ends with:
```
Status (see S1894ExactMissing): the arithmetic side of D5 is complete for
E'/F' (S1720 reduction/split reduction, S1724/S1721 torsion 2*3, S1725 mu_6
carrier and l-coprimality at the selected bad place above 5 or 7).  The one
open mathematical input is the Serre-style large-image statement for the actual
mod-l image; it is not a formal consequence of any object in the tree and no
proof of it is introduced here.
-/
```
I'll add:
```
The basis-independence is proved for an arbitrary punctured elliptic curve
(section 7), so it applies verbatim to the S1667 curve over S1687Field (S1715)
and to the S1280 concrete Gaussian curve as well.

Machine-checked summary of the gap (all EXIT=0, axioms: propext,
Classical.choice, Quot.sound only):

* S1894SL2_eq_detKer : SL_2(F_l) = det.ker inside GL_2(F_l);
* S1894GenImageTail_congr : the containment is basis independent;
* S1894ImageContainsSL2_iff : the D5 image input = rank-two basis gap AND the
  basis-free large-image condition;
* S1894ExactMissing_iff_serre : the first missing input is literally
  SerreStyleLargeImageStatement E' l;
* S1894SourceTorsionClause : the paper's Definition 3.1(c) record for E'/F'
  with the basis-free image field; every other field is a theorem
  (S1724/S1721 torsion 2*3, S1725 mu_6 carrier, l-coprimality, representation
  surjectivity).
```

Let me apply that edit, add `#print axioms` lines for the generic ones, compile, verify, hash.

content.arguments:
{"code": "const p = "D:\\lean\\tmp\\sheaf\\xif\\paper\\S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean";
await tools.edit({ file_path: p, old_string: `open mathematical input is the Serre-style large-image statement for the actual
mod-l image; it is not a formal consequence of any object in the tree and no
proof of it is introduced here.
-/`,
  new_string: `open mathematical input is the Serre-style large-image statement for the actual
mod-l image; it is not a formal consequence of any object in the tree and no
proof of it is introduced here.

The basis-independence argument is proved for an arbitrary punctured elliptic
curve (section 7), so it applies verbatim to the S1667 curve over S1687Field
(S1715) and to the S1280 concrete Gaussian curve of the paper route as well.

Machine-checked summary of the gap:

* S1894SL2_eq_detKer : SL_2(F_l) is exactly det.ker inside GL_2(F_l);
* S1894GenImageTail_congr : the containment is independent of the basis;
* S1894ImageContainsSL2_iff : the D5 image input is exactly the rank-two basis
  gap together with the basis-free large-image condition;
* S1894ExactMissing_iff_serre : the first missing input is literally the frozen
  'SerreStyleLargeImageStatement E' l' of the tree;
* S1894SourceTorsionClause : the paper's Definition 3.1(c) record for E'/F'
  with the basis-free image field, every other field being a theorem
  (S1724/S1721 torsion 2*3, S1725 mu_6 carrier and l-coprimality, surjectivity
  of the representation onto its range).

All declarations below depend only on propext, Classical.choice and
Quot.sound; see the axiom footprint at the end.
-/` });
await tools.edit({ file_path: p, old_string: `#print axioms S1894LargeImageInput_of_clause`,
  new_string: `#print axioms S1894LargeImageInput_of_clause
#print axioms S1894GenMatrixRep_acts
#print axioms S1894GenMatrixRep_conj
#print axioms S1894GenMatrixRep_range_conj
#print axioms S1894GenImageTail_congr
#print axioms S1894GenImageContainsSL2_iff_forall
#print axioms S1894GenImageTail_curve` });
const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "Final compile of S1894",
  command: `lake env lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1894D5LargeImageActual.olean tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1894D5LargeImageActual.lean > _s1894out.log 2>&1
Write-Output "EXIT=$LASTEXITCODE"
Write-Output "--- lines ---"
(Get-Content _s1894out.log | Measure-Object -Line).Lines
Write-Output "--- errors/warnings ---"
Select-String -Path _s1894out.log -Pattern 'error|warning|sorry' | Select-Object -First 20
Write-Output "--- axiom summary ---"
Select-String -Path _s1894out.log -Pattern 'depends on axioms|does not depend' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } | Sort-Object -Unique | Select-Object -First 40`,
  workdir: "D:\\lean",
  timeoutMs: 900000,
});
console.log(r.kind==='foreground'? `exit=${r.exitCode}\n` + r.stdout.text : JSON.stringify(r));", "description": "Final compile with clean error scan"}
